name: The heavan Reborn
description:
此房為重度模組房 怪物已不同以往請特別小心 (此房僅使用市集模組）

新增了數種別具風格的強大boss

還有新礦洞 新結構 新生態

各個模組細節都在開局說明書裡 請找個地方保留好 以備不時之需

後期有到下界推薦先挖石英 可合成強大的快遞手機

直接透過經驗值購買強大物品

有死亡不掉落!!!!!

其餘的 請自行探索吧~避免失去遊玩體驗

此房沒有特定規矩 除非惡意使用uot;破壞性uot;作弊

干擾其他玩家 管理員才會介入

最後的最後 為了確保遊玩體驗

請將遊戲語言設置成簡體中文

不然絕大部分物品皆是英文

有保留成就

-------------------------------------------------

This is a heavily modded world. Mobs are completely different from vanilla, so please stay cautious. （Only use marketplace addons)

Several unique and powerful new bosses have been added, along with new caves, structures and biomes.

All details about the mods are included in the in-game guidebook you get at spawn. Please keep it somewhere safe for future reference.

When you head to the Nether in the late game, mine Nether Quartz first. It can be crafted into a handy Pocket Delivery Phone.

You can purchase powerful items directly using experience points.

Keep Inventory on death is enabled!

For the best gameplay experience, feel free to explore everything on your own.

There are no strict server rules. Admins will only intervene if players use destructive cheats to harass or ruin the experience for others.

Achievements are still available.
